description: This file defines a diagnostic rule for the Roslyn analyzer, specifically to enforce that RPC interfaces do not contain properties. It includes constants for diagnostic identification, message formatting, and a method to create diagnostics based on interface and property symbols.

classes.name: RpcInterfacePropertyDiagnostic
classes.description: A static class that defines a diagnostic rule to ensure RPC interfaces do not contain properties, including constants for rule identification and a method to generate diagnostics.

methods.name: CreateDiagnostic
methods.description: Creates a Diagnostic object indicating the presence of a property in an RPC interface, used for reporting diagnostics in code analysis.
